name: territory-plan
title: Territory and quota plan
for_each: select id,name from plans where status='draft' order by name

sections.title: Territories
sections.sql: select t.code,t.name,r.name rep,p.currency,t.quota_cents from territories t join reps r on r.id=t.rep_id join plans p on p.id=t.plan_id where t.plan_id=$1 order by t.code

sections.title: Account allocations
sections.sql: select account,territory,rep,workload,rationale from v_coverage where plan_id=$1 order by account

name: approval-record
title: Approved sales plan
for_each: select id,name from plans where status='approved' order by name

sections.title: Frozen account allocations
sections.sql: select x->>'account' account,x->>'territory' territory,x->>'rep' rep,x->>'workload' workload from plans p, jsonb_array_elements(p.snapshot->'coverage') x where p.id=$1 order by x->>'account'

sections.title: Frozen territory quotas
sections.sql: select x->>'code' territory,x->>'rep' rep,p.currency,(x->>'quota_cents')::bigint quota_cents from plans p, jsonb_array_elements(p.snapshot->'territories') x where p.id=$1 order by x->>'code'
